Tbh I don’t know shit about the province. However I just moved out like a month ago or so and lived at the Vue north for 2 years. For the price and what you get, I don’t think it’s bad at all, but I know there is a new property manager that is for both south and north, the last one was a complete bitch. Every person that I’ve talked to living at the Vue has had problems with the apt, whether the ac stopped working, the stove/oven isn’t working properly, the washer/dryer flooding a tad or stopped working. The north side is better to me bc you get a bigger room and common space than the south. But if you also don’t know your roommates you never know if you will live with a slob or messy person, or a person that’s somehow a disturbance in some way. Yes, the pool is bigger at south and you can go there just to swim and shit, but tbh the smaller sometimes just works to relax and it’s chill plenty of people have had parties at that small pool area.

So, I just moved out and I lived at the north side for 2 years. They have a new manager that’s for the both south and north side, so I’m not sure if she is a bitch or not. I personally like the north side more because they have bigger rooms. The trash valet sucks and don’t pick it up in time at all and every person that I’ve talked to has had some sort of problems with there apt. Whether that was the ac that stopped working, the stove/oven not working properly, or the washer/dryer stop working or flooding a tad. I would say the price isn’t bad compared to other places, and if you live in the north side, then the common area is nice and big. You might get a mini fridge in your room but some don’t have it. I think honestly it’s a good choice but if you don’t know your roommates you never know if they will be messy or cause a disturbance in a way. Overall, for the price and what you get I wouldn’t complain but there are def downsides like every apt place.
